# Headstart Mentoring

> One-on-one online career mentoring for international students in Australia.
> Mentors are recent graduates and early-career professionals working in
> Australia who were international students themselves, so they have been
> through the same visa, networking and hiring process recently.

Headstart Mentoring helps international students in Australia land their first
graduate role or internship. Students are matched with a mentor working in
their target industry. Every engagement starts with a free discovery call to
understand the student's situation and match them to the right mentor.

## What we do

- **1-on-1 mentoring**: recurring online sessions with a matched mentor,
  covering resumes, LinkedIn, networking, interviews, assessment centres and
  offer negotiation.
- **Mentor matching**: students are matched by target industry (finance,
  accounting, tech, marketing, consulting, data and analytics, engineering).
  Students can change mentors at no extra cost.
- **Free discovery call**: a short, no-obligation call to understand the
  student's job search situation and match them with a mentor.
- **Job alerts**: a weekly, hand-checked list of graduate roles and
  internships in Australia that are open to international students, filtered
  by major and city (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane).

## Who it is for

International students studying in Australia, typically final-year
undergraduate and postgraduate students, who are looking for a graduate role
or internship and are navigating visa questions, limited local networks and
Australian hiring processes.

- [Home](https://theheadstartmentoring.com/): what Headstart is and who it serves.
- [Mentors](https://theheadstartmentoring.com/mentors): mentor profiles, their industries and backgrounds.
- [Free discovery call](https://theheadstartmentoring.com/discovery-call): book the intake call.
- [Reviews](https://theheadstartmentoring.com/reviews): outcomes and testimonials from mentees.
- [Job alerts](https://theheadstartmentoring.com/job-alerts): current roles open to international students.
- [Careers](https://theheadstartmentoring.com/careers): open roles at Headstart, including mentor positions.

## Facts

- Service area: Australia (mentees nationwide; mentors concentrated in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane).
- Delivery: online, one-on-one.
- Mentors: recent graduates and early-career professionals who were themselves international students in Australia.
- Entry point: a free discovery call. There is no charge to be matched or to attend the first call.
